Gameplay and Features
One-Button Controls: A single click or tap makes both players on your team jump and kick forward at the same time.
Constant Randomness: After each goal, the game shifts to a new environment, changing the pitch conditions (like a snowy or beach field), player outfits, goalposts, and the ball itself.
Win Condition: The first team to reach five goals wins the match.
Game Modes: Play solo against the computer (CPU) or locally with a friend in a two-player mode on the same device.
